duplicator.description: returns a newly allocated copy of its input; may return NULL on failure

null_on_failure.description: function that may return NULL on failure; its result must be checked before use

length_of.description: computes the length of a null-terminated string; dereferences its pointer argument

allocator.description: allocates a block of memory; may return NULL on failure

deallocator.description: frees memory previously allocated by an allocator or duplicator
